newsitem.title: ITALY: Banca di Roma sees higher 1st half profit.
newsitem.headline: Banca di Roma sees higher 1st half profit.

text.p: Banca di Roma, Italy's second largest banking group, said on Thursday that based on available data, 1996 first half profit showed a "considerable improvement" over the same period of 1995.
The bank said in a brief statement that the results for the six months had still to be approved by the board.

For the first half 1995 Banca di Roma posted parent net profit of 53.1 billion lire, against 8.6 billion lire a year earlier. For the full 1995 year it reported parent net profit of 88.3 billion lire, up from 44 billion in the previous year.
